games.name: ARCHEMARA [EARLY ACCESS]
games.desc:
Archemara is a combat-intensive co-op PVE dungeon crawler.

Archemara is currently in Early Access, your patience with any encountered bug or inconvenience is greatly appreciated!

MAIN CONTROLS
X - Draw & holster
F - Healing flask
Tab - Index Menu & close menus
M1 - Primary moveset
M1 + Shift - Secondary moveset
M1 + Ctrl - Tertiary moveset
M2 - Block & Parry
MMB - Target lock-on
Space - Dodge

All roadmaps, patch notes, & discussions are held in the Battle Core Games server.

games.name: 🌸 Fruit Juice Tycoon: Refreshed
games.desc:
THE DEVELOPER BIRTHDAY BASH BEGINS! Birthday items return for a short time as balloons swarm the map! The summer event has also been extended by a week, with various improvements and boosts to help you finish off your journey to sparkling coconut mastery!

Relive a 2010 classic with this expanded remake! This fan-made "refreshed" version brings the game closer to modern Roblox standards with new mechanics and polished visuals, while still trying to keep a similar feel to the original gameplay. 

This game is still in development. Your progress, unlocks, and stats will never be erased by updates, but adjustments may be made. 

Your feedback means the world to us! Big or small, send it our way in the group wall or our community server. 

This game is maintained and monetized with the full permission of the original creator of FJT, tycoonworldmaker. If you own VIP from the original game, it will work here.

games.name: Prison Roleplay: Escape Plan
games.desc:
Welcome to Escape Plan! (The best prison RP!)

👮‍♀️ Choose the life of a guard, serving to maintain the peace and uphold order within the prison by subduing hostile inmates, confiscating contraband, and assisting the police in their efforts of catching criminals, climbing your way to the top of the ranks!

⛓️ Or perhaps you're more suited to the life of an inmate? Sentenced to life behind bars, your job is to form an escape plan and free yourself from the jail, crushing any opposition in your way!

❤️ Make sure to leave a like for more updates!

Inspired by Redwood Prison and Prison Life
